howto.what: 启用插件后自动生效：在 SessionStart 和 UserPromptSubmit 时注入静态项目规则，Codex apply_patch 之后按文件匹配注入对应规则；动态输出只作为附加上下文注入、按会话去重，不改写工具输出。
howto.when: 当你问起 Codex Rules 的行为、支持的规则文件位置或环境配置等问题时接管。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Codex Rules runs automatically: static project instructions are injected on SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit, and matching file rules after apply_patch. Dynamic output is added as extra context, deduplicated per session.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.
